_comment: ARMOURED kit: the rounds-count tally beside a gun well - the marking class, and the kit's ONE use of stencil white. FLAT geometry like the hazard band, a decal drawn as thin boxes: four white stripes and a fifth struck diagonally through them on a dark painted-out backing, 0.021 cells proud in total. Flat is load-bearing here, not just cheap - the rule seats this piece on CONES (the plates beside a boom-mounted gun are cones, bench-proven on asym_gunship), and a piece with no height is the only thing that can lie on a mean-height seat without reading as hovering. Stripes run +Z so align Run lays the tally down the well's edge.
